quality_check.description: A single vertically oriented screen-printed atlas-card image with a thick distressed soot-black outer edge, narrow bone-white margin, inset illustration window, worn corners, matte grain, and slight print irregularity. A large black swan dominates the center as it strikes a compact geometric landscape. Vermilion fracture lines and a circular impact pattern radiate from beneath the bird, cutting across and displacing bridges, towers, grids, and architectural forms. The palette is primarily soot-black, bone-white, pale gray, storm blue-gray, oxidized teal, and vermilion. Thin technical arcs and construction lines cross the scene and visibly break or diverge around the disruption. No readable text, captions, labels, interfaces, collage structure, or multiple panels are visible.

Edit

Emphasize scale and disruption through the low viewpoint, bold soot-black silhouettes, restrained storm blue-gray and oxidized teal, bone-white and pale-stone fields, crisp screen-printed contours with occasional dry-ink breaks, and graphic high-contrast matte lighting. Thin technical-drawing lines should visibly split, diverge, or fail as the shock passes through them. Use style_reference only to preserve the established rendering vocabulary and material treatment; use world_keyframe only to maintain the recurring world palette, print-window grammar, texture, and lighting; use previous_beat as binding continuity for frame material, edge treatment, palette, texture, and lighting while creating a completely new composition, camera angle, subject placement, and focal action. No photorealism, glossy CGI, anime, watercolor, sepia engraving, neon palette, readable interfaces, text, letters, numbers, captions, labels, storyboard, grid, collage, or multiple panels. NON-NEGOTIABLE EPISODE FRAME CONTRACT: Preserve this recurring frame language in this image: every image appears inside the same vertically oriented screen-printed atlas card: a thick imperfect soot-black outer print edge, narrow bone-white breathing margin, and a slightly inset rectangular illustration window with tiny registration offsets and worn ink corners. Diagrams, environments, swans, tools, markets, and technology scenes all remain inside this repeated print-window grammar, with the border thickness and inner margins held consistent throughout the episode. Preserve its material/edge grammar, texture, palette and inner illustration window while changing only the scene inside it. Do not reserve a lower caption field, blank strip, empty panel or low-detail band. Continue the scene and its natural texture through the full usable height, guided by the previous accepted image, without adding text, letters, numbers, captions, labels, words or UI.
